device_analysis.description: Two horizontally-aligned U-shaped waveguide paths. Top path: straight right, 180-degree U-bend upward, straight back left. Bottom path: straight right, 180-degree U-bend downward, straight back left. Both start/end at same horizontal positions.
device_analysis.function: Balanced delay line pair for interferometry (MZI arms)
device_analysis.corrected_understanding: Iteration 1 was COMPLETELY WRONG - used S-bends for a crossing. Diff shows large U-shaped sections missing. Device is two parallel horizontal U-bends.
functional_knobs: wg_width: waveguide width - determines single-mode operation
u_depth: vertical extent of each U from centerline
straight_length: length of horizontal straight sections

iterations.change_made: Initial attempt - wrong topology (S-bends, crossing). Total failure.
Adjusted bend radius and straight length - got worse
Switched to S-bend diverge/converge topology - completely wrong
Back to U-bends with bend_radius=1um, straight_length=59um - worst result yet

failure_summary: Failed to converge after 6 iterations. Never exceeded IoU=0.12. Core issue: misunderstood device topology despite multiple attempts. Footprint (120x4) suggests very wide, flat device but could not deduce correct primitive assembly.
